title: Integration of epigenomic and genomic data to predict residual feed intake and the feed conversion ratio in dairy sheep via machine learning algorithms
summary: Neural-network, random-forest and XGBoost models used DMR methylation features to predict sheep feed-efficiency traits; the Methods report only 21 animals and the Discussion explicitly cautions about sample size.
